source: Kapchorua Tea Kenya Plc unaudited group results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, reported 12 November 2026. Printed figures in KES: revenue 932.7 million (up 12.4 per cent), operating profit before tax 133.4 million (up 77.4 per cent), fair value gains on biological assets 32.2 million (down 18.4 per cent), finance income 28.1 million (up 26.2 per cent), profit before tax 193.7 million (up 41.5 per cent), profit after tax 131.2 million (up 37.9 per cent), earnings per share 8.39 (up 38.0 per cent). Balance sheet: total assets 4.36 billion, shareholders equity 3.22 billion, cash and bank balances 562.4 million. Operating cash flow 200.5 million and dividends paid 460.9 million. Coverage: Business Daily, Business Today and The Kenyan Wallstreet, 12 November 2026. The three printed lines tie: operating profit 133.4 million plus fair value gains 32.2 million plus finance income 28.1 million equals the printed profit before tax of 193.7 million.
source_note: Unaudited interim period, six months ended 30 September 2026. Figures taken from the issuer's own results announcement as reported on 12 November 2026.
